notes: Tuition: the collegegeld pages give an instellingscollegegeld (institutional fee) for voltijd of EUR 10,360 (2026-2027) / EUR 5,833 (Feb 2026) / EUR 9,999 (2025-2026), but this is a general institution-wide figure not stated for this programme and the pages do not state which rate a non-EU student pays for Informatica; left out. Intakes: pages give September 2026 (apply by 1 August 2026, or 1 May 2026 for toelatingsrecht) and February 2027 (apply by 15 January 2027) for Inholland generally, not necessarily for this programme, and no full day-month-year start date is quoted for this programme; left out. Documents: no document list is stated for this programme on the supplied pages.

evidence.quote: Students who have completed their prior education abroad must therefore demonstrate Dutch language proficiency at B2 level (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages).

note.fr: Faites évaluer votre diplôme marocain par la CSA ; envoyez diplôme, relevé de notes et, si besoin, une traduction certifiée via Selfservice.
note.en: Have your Moroccan diploma evaluated by the CSA; upload your diploma, transcript and, if needed, a sworn translation via Selfservice.

evidence.quote: De CSA beoordeelt alleen diploma’s nadat je een aanmelding via Studielink hebt gedaan en je diploma, cijferlijst, en, indien nodig, een vertaling van een beëdigd vertaler, hebt geüpload in Selfservice.

note.fr: Date limite de candidature pour les étudiants non-UE : 1 mai.
note.en: Application deadline for non-EU students: 1 May.
